cues.en: Let's take a closer look.
cues.zh: 仔細看看。

cues.zh: 回到 Jupyter Notebook。

cues.en: Make sure that you're in the Rexces environment first and import the keras.ipymb file from the deep learning into folder.
cues.zh: 先確認在 RecSys 環境，再上傳 DeepLearningIntro 資料夾中的 Keras.ipynb。

cues.en: Once it's uploaded, select it to fire up that notebook.
cues.zh: 上傳後，選取它，開啟 Notebook。

cues.en: Again, Keras is just a higher level API in Tensorflow that makes deep learning a lot easier.
cues.zh: 再次提醒，Keras 只是 TensorFlow 的高階 API，讓深度學習容易得多。

cues.en: We'll start off by importing all the stuff we need, the Keras API and some specific modules from it.
cues.zh: 先匯入需要的所有東西，Keras API，以及其中一些特定模組。

cues.en: We have the mnist dataset here that we're going to experiment with and we'll import the sequential model which is a very quick way of assembling the layers of a neural network.
cues.zh: 這裡有要實驗的 MNIST 資料集，也匯入 Sequential 模型，能非常快速地組合神經網路各層。

cues.en: We're going to import the dense and dropout layers as well so we can actually add some new things into this neural network to make it even better and prevent over-fitting.
cues.zh: 也匯入 Dense 與 Dropout 層，能在神經網路加入新東西，讓它更好，避免過度擬合。

cues.en: Finally, we will import the RMSprop optimizer which is what we're going to use for our gradient descent.
cues.zh: 最後，匯入 RMSprop 最佳化器，用於梯度下降。

cues.en: Hit shift+enter to process that block.
cues.zh: 按 Shift+Enter，處理這個區塊。

cues.en: Let's go ahead and load up the mnist dataset that we used in the previous example.
cues.zh: 載入前一個範例使用的 MNIST 資料集。

cues.en: Keras's version is a little bit different.
cues.zh: Keras 版本有點不同。

cues.en: It actually has 60,000 training samples as opposed to 55,000, but still 10,000 test samples.
cues.zh: 實際有 60,000 個訓練樣本，而不是 55,000，但測試樣本仍是 10,000 個。

cues.en: That's just a one line operation.
cues.zh: 只需要一行。

cues.en: Next we need to convert this to the shape that Tensorflow expects under the hood.
cues.zh: 接著，轉成底層 TensorFlow 預期的形狀。

cues.en: So we're going to reshape the training data to 60,000 by 784.
cues.zh: 因此，把訓練資料重塑成 60,000×784。

cues.en: We're still going to treat these as 1D images.
cues.zh: 仍將它們視為一維影像。

cues.en: We're going to flatten these all out into one dimension of 784 pixels for each 28 by 28 image.
cues.zh: 把每張 28×28 影像，攤平成一維的 784 個像素。

cues.en: We also have our test dataset of 10,000 images, each with 784 pixels apiece and we'll explicitly cast the images as floating .32 bit values which is just something
cues.zh: 測試資料集則有 10,000 張影像，每張也有 784 個像素；明確轉成 32 位元浮點數，

cues.en: to make the libraries a little bit happier.
cues.zh: 只是為了讓函式庫更好處理。

cues.en: Furthermore, we're going to normalize these things by dividing by 255.
cues.zh: 另外，將它們除以 255，進行正規化。

cues.en: The image data here is actually eight bit at the source so it ranges from zero to 255.
cues.zh: 來源影像資料，其實是八位元，因此從零到 255。

cues.en: To convert that to the range zero to one, we covert it to a floating point number first and then divide it by 255 to rescale that input data to the range zero to one.
cues.zh: 要轉成零到一，先轉浮點數，再除以 255，將輸入資料重新縮放到零到一。

cues.en: We talked before about the importance of normalizing your input data and that's all we're doing here.
cues.zh: 前面談過輸入資料正規化的重要性，這裡就是在做這件事。

cues.en: Hit shift+enter to run this block and we'll move on.
cues.zh: 按 Shift+Enter 執行，再繼續。

cues.en: As before, we'll convert our labels into one-hot format.
cues.zh: 和之前一樣，將標籤轉成獨熱格式。

cues.en: That's what two categorical does for you.
cues.zh: 這就是 to_categorical 的工作。

cues.en: It just coverts the label data on both the training and test dataset to one-hot zero to 10 values.
cues.zh: 它只把訓練集與測試集的標籤資料，轉成零到十的獨熱值。

cues.en: Let's select this block and run it as well.
cues.zh: 選取這個區塊，也執行它。

cues.en: Next we'll visualize some of that data just to make sure that it loaded up successfully.
cues.zh: 接著，視覺化部分資料，確認成功載入。

cues.en: This is pretty much the same as the previous example.
cues.zh: 與前一個例子大致相同。

cues.en: We're just going to look at our input data for the sample number 1234 and we can see that our one-hot label here is showing one in position four.
cues.zh: 查看樣本 1234 的輸入資料，可以看到獨熱標籤，在第四個位置是一。

cues.en: We start counting at zero.
cues.zh: 我們從零開始計數。

cues.en: Zero, one, two, three, our label's three.
cues.zh: 零、一、二、三，標籤是三。

cues.en: Argmax gives us back the human readable label and by reshaping that 768 pixel array into a 2D shape we can see that this is somebody's attempt to draw the number three.
cues.zh: argmax 傳回人類易讀的標籤，把 784 像素陣列重塑成二維後，可以看到，這是某人嘗試寫數字三。

cues.en: So far so good.
cues.zh: 到目前都很好。

cues.en: Our data looks like it makes sense and it was loaded correctly.
cues.zh: 資料看來合理，也正確載入。

cues.en: Now remember back when we were dealing with Tensorflow.
cues.zh: 回想先前使用 TensorFlow 時，

cues.en: We had to do a whole bunch of work to set up our neural network.
cues.zh: 必須做很多工作，設定神經網路。

cues.en: Well look at how much easier it is with Keras.
cues.zh: 看看 Keras 有多簡單。

cues.en: All we needed to do is say that we're setting up a sequential model which allows us to add individual layers to our neural network one layer at a time, sequentially if you will.
cues.zh: 只要設定 Sequential 模型，就能依序，一次一層，把個別層加入神經網路。

cues.en: We start off by adding a dense layer of 512 neurons with an input shape of 784 neurons.
cues.zh: 先加入 512 個神經元的 Dense 層，輸入形狀是 784 個神經元。

cues.en: So this is our first layer that takes our 784 input signals from each image, one for each pixel.
cues.zh: 這是第一層，接收每張影像的 784 個輸入訊號，每個像素一個。

cues.en: It feeds it into a hidden layer of 512 neurons and those neurons will have the ReLU activation function associated with them.
cues.zh: 再送入 512 個神經元的隱藏層，使用 ReLU 激活函數。

cues.en: So with one line of code we've done a whole lot of work that we had to do in Tensorflow before and then on top of that, we'll put a softmax activation function on top of it to a final layer of 10 output units
cues.zh: 因此，一行程式碼，就完成先前 TensorFlow 的大量工作，再加上 softmax 激活函數，接到最後十個輸出單元的層，

cues.en: which we'll map to our final classification of what number this represents from zero to nine.
cues.zh: 對應零到九的最終數字分類。

cues.en: That was easy.
cues.zh: 很容易。

cues.en: Let's execute this block before we forget.
cues.zh: 別忘了，先執行這個區塊。

cues.en: We can even ask Keras to give us back a summary of what we set up just to make sure that things look the way we expected and sure enough, we have two layers here.
cues.zh: 甚至可以請 Keras 列出設定摘要，確認符合預期。果然，這裡有兩層。

cues.en: One that has 512 and then going to a 10 neuron layer for the final classification.
cues.zh: 一層有 512 個神經元，再到最後分類的十個神經元層。

cues.en: Now you might also remember that it was kind of a pain to set the optimization and loss functions in the lower level API, but that's a one liner in Keras.
cues.zh: 也許記得，低階 API 設定最佳化與損失函數，有點麻煩，但 Keras 只要一行。

cues.en: All we have to do is say that our loss function is categorical crossentropy and it will know what to do from there.
cues.zh: 只要說損失函數是 categorical_crossentropy，它就知道該怎麼做。

cues.en: We're going to use the RMSprop optimizer.
cues.zh: 使用 RMSprop 最佳化器。

cues.en: You could use Adam instead if you wanted to.
cues.zh: 想要的話，也可以用 Adam。

cues.en: There are other choices like Adagrad and SGD and you can read up on those in this link here in the notebook if you want to.
cues.zh: 還有 Adagrad、SGD 等選擇，有興趣可從 Notebook 這個連結了解。

cues.en: Go ahead and run that and Keras will build the underlying graph that we want to run.
cues.zh: 執行後，Keras 會建立需要的底層計算圖。

cues.en: So now we have to actually run it and again, that's just one line of code with Keras.
cues.zh: 接著，要真正執行，同樣，Keras 只要一行程式碼。

cues.en: All we have to do is say that we're going to fit this model using the training dataset.
cues.zh: 只要說，用訓練資料集擬合這個模型。

cues.en: These are the input features and labels that we're going to train with.
cues.zh: 這些是要用來訓練的輸入特徵與標籤。

cues.en: We want to use batch size of 100.
cues.zh: 批次大小設為 100。

cues.en: We're going to run that over 10 epochs.
cues.zh: 執行十個訓練週期。

cues.en: I'm going to set up a verbose level of two because that's what works best with a Jupyter notebook.
cues.zh: verbose 層級設為二，因為最適合 Jupyter Notebook。

cues.en: And for validation we will provide the test dataset as well.
cues.zh: 驗證時，也提供測試資料集。

cues.en: So instead of writing this big function that does this iteration of learning by hand like we did in Tensorflow, Keras does it all for us.
cues.zh: 因此，不必像 TensorFlow 那樣，手寫一大段反覆學習的函數，Keras 全部替我們處理。

cues.en: Let's go ahead and hit shift+enter and kick that off.
cues.zh: 按 Shift+Enter，開始執行。

cues.en: Keras used to be considerably slower than using Tensorflow's lower level APIs because it's doing a little bit more work under the hood.
cues.zh: Keras 以前明顯比直接用 TensorFlow 低階 API 慢，因為底層做了更多工作。

cues.en: But in today's Tensorflow it's pretty fast and you'll see that the results are really good.
cues.zh: 但現在的 TensorFlow 很快，你會看到結果很好。

cues.en: I mean even on the second iteration we've already surpassed the accuracy that we got after 20 iterations in our hand coded Tensorflow implementation.
cues.zh: 甚至第二次迭代，就超過手寫 TensorFlow 實作二十次迭代後的準確率。

cues.en: At epoch six we're approaching 99% accuracy.
cues.zh: 第六個訓練週期，接近 99% 準確率。

cues.en: Keep in mind this is measuring the accuracy in the training dataset.
cues.zh: 記得，這衡量的是訓練資料集的準確率。

cues.en: And we're almost there.
cues.zh: 快完成了。

cues.en: I mean even with just 10 epochs we've done a lot better than using Tensorflow.
cues.zh: 只用十個訓練週期，就比直接用 TensorFlow 好很多。

cues.en: And again, Keras is doing a lot of the right things for you automatically without making you even think about it.
cues.zh: 同樣，Keras 自動替你做很多正確的事，甚至不用思考。

cues.en: That's the power of Keras.
cues.zh: 這就是 Keras 的威力。

cues.en: Even though it can be a little slower, it might give you better results with less effort at the end of the day.
cues.zh: 即使可能稍慢，最後仍可能用更少心力，得到更好結果。

cues.en: Now here's something that we couldn't really do easily with Tensorflow.
cues.zh: 現在，有件事是前面用 TensorFlow 不容易做到的。

cues.en: It's possible, but I didn't get into it because the previous lecture was long enough as it was.
cues.zh: 可以做，但上一堂已經夠長，所以沒深入。

cues.en: But remember that we can actually integrate Keras with scikit-learn so we can just say model.evaluate and our Keras model is just like a scikit-learn model as far as Python's concerned.
cues.zh: 記得，Keras 能與 scikit-learn 整合，因此只要寫 model.evaluate，對 Python 來說，Keras 模型就像 scikit-learn 模型。

cues.en: And now we can actually measure accuracy based on our test dataset.
cues.zh: 現在，能真正根據測試資料集衡量準確率。

cues.en: Using the test dataset as a benchmark, it had a 90% success rate in correctly classifying those images.
cues.zh: 以測試資料集為基準，正確分類這些影像的成功率是 90%。

cues.en: So that's not bad.
cues.zh: 還不差。

cues.en: Later in the course we'll talk about some better approaches that we can use, but hey, that's a lot better than we got in the previous lecture, isn't it?
cues.zh: 課程稍後會談更好的方法，但嘿，這已經比上一堂好得多，對吧？

cues.en: As before, let's go ahead and take a look at some of the ones that it got wrong just to get a feel of where it has trouble.
cues.zh: 和之前一樣，看看哪些答錯，感受它在哪些地方有困難。

cues.en: Things where our neural network has challenges.
cues.zh: 也就是神經網路面臨挑戰的地方。

cues.en: The code here is similar.
cues.zh: 程式碼類似。

cues.en: We just go through the first 1,000 test images you see here and since it does have a much higher accuracy rate, we have to go deeper into that test data to find the examples of things that went wrong.
cues.zh: 走訪這裡前 1000 張測試影像，因為準確率高很多，必須深入更多測試資料，才能找到出錯例子。

cues.en: But it'll reshape each image into a flat 784 pixel array which is what our neural network expects as input.
cues.zh: 把每張影像重塑成平坦的 784 像素陣列，這是神經網路預期的輸入。

cues.en: We'll call argmax on the resulting classification in one-hot format and see if that predicted classification matches the actual label for that data.
cues.zh: 對獨熱格式的分類結果呼叫 argmax，檢查預測分類是否符合實際標籤。

cues.en: If not, print it out.
cues.zh: 不符合，就印出來。

cues.en: You can see here that this model really is doing better.
cues.zh: 可以看到，這個模型確實更好。

cues.en: The ones that it's getting wrong are pretty wonky.
cues.zh: 弄錯的那些，長得相當奇怪。

cues.zh: 這個例子預測是九，如果我自己看，也可能猜九。

cues.en: Turns out this person was trying to draw the number four.
cues.zh: 結果，這個人想寫的是四。

cues.en: But you know this is a case where even a human brain is going to run into trouble as to what this person was actually trying to write.
cues.zh: 但這種情況，即使人腦，也難判斷他真正想寫什麼。

cues.en: I don't know what that's supposed to be.
cues.zh: 我不知道這應該是什麼。

cues.en: Apparently they were trying to draw the number two.
cues.zh: 顯然，他想寫二。

cues.en: Our best guess was a nine.
cues.zh: 我們最佳猜測是九。

cues.en: Not unreasonable given the shape of things.
cues.zh: 根據形狀，不算不合理。

cues.en: Here is someone who was trying to draw a two, but it looks a whole lot more like a seven.
cues.zh: 這個人想寫二，卻看起來更像七。

cues.en: Again, I wouldn't be too sure about that myself.
cues.zh: 同樣，我自己也不確定。

cues.en: Even though we flattened this data to one dimension, this neural network that we've constructed is already rivaling the human brain in terms of doing handwriting recognition on these numbers.
cues.zh: 即使把資料攤成一維，這個神經網路，在這些數字的手寫辨識上，已經能與人腦較量。

cues.en: I mean that's kind of amazing.
cues.zh: 這真的很驚人。

cues.zh: 那個，我大概不會猜三；但可以看到，讓它遇到困難的資料，品質都很可疑。

cues.en: I mean...
cues.zh: 我是說……

cues.en: Some people really can't write.
cues.zh: 有些人真的不太會寫字。

cues.en: Just by using Keras alone we've gotten better accuracy.
cues.zh: 光是使用 Keras，就得到更好的準確率。

cues.en: We've achieved a better result because there's less for us to think about.
cues.zh: 因為要思考的東西更少，得到更好的結果。

cues.en: You can probably improve on this even more.
cues.zh: 你可能還能進一步改善。

cues.en: So again, as before, I want you to go back and see if you can actually improve on these results.
cues.zh: 所以，像之前一樣，回去看看，能否改善結果。

cues.en: Try using a different optimizer than RMSprop.
cues.zh: 試試 RMSprop 以外的最佳化器。

cues.en: Try different topologies.
cues.zh: 試試不同拓樸。

cues.en: And the beauty with Keras is that it's a lot easier to try those different topologies now.
cues.zh: Keras 的好處，是現在嘗試不同拓樸容易得多。

cues.en: Keras actually comes with an example of using mnist and here's the actual topology that they used in their example.
cues.zh: Keras 其實附有 MNIST 範例，這是它的範例實際使用的拓樸。

cues.en: Go back and give that a try.
cues.zh: 回去試試。

cues.en: See if it's actually any better or not.
cues.zh: 看看是否真的更好。

cues.en: See if you can improve upon things.
cues.zh: 看看能否改善。

cues.en: One thing you can see here is that they're actually adding dropout layers to prevent over-fitting.
cues.zh: 可以看到，實際加入 Dropout 層，防止過度擬合。

cues.en: So it's very easy to add those sorts of features here.
cues.zh: 因此，這裡很容易加入這類功能。

cues.en: Basically what we've done here is add that same dense layer of 512 hidden neurons, taking the 784 features and then we're going to drop out 20% of the neuron's thinnest layer to force the learning
cues.zh: 基本上，加上相同的 512 個隱藏神經元 Dense 層，接受 784 個特徵，再隨機丟棄這層 20% 神經元，強迫學習
